mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_registry (bot_id, label, wechat_user_id, wechat_bot_id, bot_token, base_url, last_active_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{botId}, #{label}, #{wechatUserId}, #{wechatBotId}, #{botToken}, #{baseUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = COALESCE(new.label, bot_registry.label), wechat_user_id = COALESCE(new.wechatUserId, bot_registry.wechat_user_id), wechat_bot_id = COALESCE(new.wechatBotId, bot_registry.wechat_bot_id), bot_token = COALESCE(new.botToken, bot_registry.bot_token), base_url = COALESCE(new.baseUrl, bot_registry.base_url), last_active_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT bot_id AS botId, label, wechat_user_id AS wechatUserId, wechat_bot_id AS wechatBotId, bot_token AS botToken, base_url AS baseUrl, created_at AS createdAt, last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM bot_registry ORDER BY created_at ASC
